limitations: Historical weather replay: each strategy is run under the same past seasons. This is not a forecast and not a probability of crop success; it says nothing about yield or profit.
Weather is one NASA POWER grid cell (meteorology about 0.5° × 0.625°, radiation 1°), mean elevation 638 m: regional, not a field measurement.

Water balance assumptions: constant rooting depth from planting, no capillary rise, curve number for average antecedent moisture, irrigation refills to field capacity when RAW is depleted (net, no application losses).
Crop parameters are FAO-56 tabulated values, not calibrated for local hybrids, and are labelled draft until an agronomist reviews them.
Kc climate adjustments limit stage-mean wind to 1–6 m/s and RHmin to 20–80%; per-season kc_climate_qa records original and used values and limiting flags.
Frozen external weather screening did not qualify nationally; station-season rainfall and ET0 failures remain. These simulations are exploratory and do not establish field irrigation accuracy.
Soil is the dominant component of the SSURGO map unit; other soils in the map unit can differ. TAW from NRCS available water capacity; the 1/3-15 bar alternative is shown as a sensitivity check.
Sample mode: saved NASA and USDA records, not a live retrieval.
Current practice is unknown, so no strategy is labelled as current practice.
